summary.text: Brad Banderman is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 119 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A pastor, he lives in St. Clair, Missouri, and is vice chair of the Elementary and Secondary Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Banderman was born in Festus, Missouri, lives in St. Clair, and graduated from Union R-XIII High School in 1995.
He earned a bachelor's degree in religion from Missouri Baptist College in 1998.
His career experience includes working as a substitute teacher and bus driver for the St. Clair R-XIII School District and as a student pastor for Bethel Baptist Church.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, a biography written in the third person said Banderman had worked full time as student pastor of Bethel Baptist Church in Lonedell for 22 years and served as assistant chaplain for the St. Clair Police Department.
For the 2025-2026 session, he was vice chair of the Elementary and Secondary Education Committee.
